facts.quote: Auditions for annual HCO productions take place during the last week of August or first week of September.
HSA is always hiring for talented individuals to join our management team. Many of our best managers throughout the 65-year history of HSA have not come through our main fall recruitment round.
The company’s semesterly auditions are no-cuts and designed to be a fun, inclusive experience for anyone interested in performing.
